# External benchmark code

The Iqbal spike-and-slab benchmark uses the authors' reference implementation. Clone it into this directory before running either Iqbal script:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/adam-iqbal/selection-spike-slab external/selection-spike-slab
```

The following files must then exist:

```text
external/selection-spike-slab/methods/gibbs_spike_slab.R
external/selection-spike-slab/methods/utils.R
```

The external repository is not copied into this project. Its own license and citation terms continue to apply.
